summary: Re-review, art lens, 1920x1080 / 1920x1200 / 1280x720 on coast, city and mountain (real races with autopilot plus the stub and live sandbox tours). All 12 r1 correctness issues are fixed as far as the screen shows. Weapon pips match uses. Merged callouts rewrite their text (stub merge PASS). Bubbles stay clear of each other and of tags (pack/packLater/behind PASS). The BUSTED sub now reads 罚款 100 小鱼干 · 靠边 4 秒. Intro cards match race introFocus in 27/27 samples. The skill band retires under WRECKED. The distance readout sits right of the flag. Down labels, the incoming chip and callouts held through cinematics all work. The static HUD and cut-ins are close to commercial quality: a coherent red/black/white P5 language, real portrait art with mood swaps, strong ransom-note KNOCK OUT / SHOWTIME / BUSTED / FINISH splashes, readable drift L1-L3 speedo states and crisp scaling to 720p. No console errors, and tsc is clean for src/ui/hud and sandbox/hud. It does not pass because of how it composes in real play. Name tags and taunt bubbles pile into a tall column over the road ahead in every pack, which breaks the brief's 'never covers the road ahead centre'. The progress strip also shows the whole field as a single badge for the entire race. Smaller polish problems: the siren glow washes the HUD, the place flash goes off-palette, the cluster occludes rivals alongside, the 1st-place star is hidden, the KO splash outlives short cinematics and yellow is overused. Harness note: node sandbox/hud.shots.mjs --live fails 7 asserting scenes only because it also counts the hidden game HUD instance in #ui (bubbles=4, counts=6). Evidence is under shots/review/ui-hud/r2-art/ (s-*.jpg contact sheets; tools/clutter.mjs, spread.mjs, intro.mjs, occl.mjs).

issues.title: Name tags + taunt bubbles stack into a column over the road ahead in every pack
issues.detail: world/tags.ts de-overlap lifts tags upward and world/bubbles.ts settles bubbles above them. Whenever the pack is 5-25 m ahead, 4-7 full tags (name, place, HP bar, tip, weapon chip) plus 1-2 bubbles form a vertical totem right at the vanishing point. Measured with shots/review/ui-hud/r2-art/tools/clutter.mjs (1 sample/s, first 60 s, 1080p, autopilot): 3 or more labels inside the central band (x 30-70 %, y 15-65 %) in 14/60 samples on coast seed 4 and 29/60 on city seed 2. The tallest central stack was 225 px on coast and 371 px (34 % of screen height) on city. Two city samples still had tag-on-tag overlaps (city/pack-2.5s.png: 神烦狗 under 哈基米 2, weapon chips over 鹅霸/卡皮). See r2-art/clutter-city-600.png (a 6-tag column over the road) and c720/race-a.png (4 tags + a bubble stacked dead centre at 720p). The brief's quality bar says the HUD never covers the road ahead centre.
issues.fix: Level-of-detail tags: show the full plate (name + HP + chip) only for the 2-3 most relevant rivals (nearest within ~12 m, current melee target, angry or casting). Cap full plates at 3. Collapse every other tag to a compact ~22 px place pip (species dot + place number) with no HP bar, tip or chip. Fan tags sideways from the anchor instead of lifting them into a column, and keep the area just above the vanishing point (x 38-62 %, y 25-50 %) clear: push labels out of it sideways, and dock bubbles whose speaker sits in that band to the screen side, as for off-screen speakers.

issues.title: Progress strip shows all 7 rivals as one badge for the whole race
issues.detail: progress.ts puts each 34 px rival badge at p*760 px on a single row. On that scale 3.3 km is about 4.3 m per px, and rubber banding keeps the field within ~200 m, so the badges sit on top of each other. Measured with r2-art/tools/spread.mjs over a full autopilot race (coast seed 4, every 5 s): 1 distinct badge group out of 7 rivals in 35/37 samples and 2 in the other 2, with a field span of 3-44 px. In the city run all 8 heads sat within translateX 60-63.5 px at 13 s. In coast/race-a.png, race-c.png and c720/race-a.png only YOU and one red badge peeking above it are visible. The portraits only read once I teleported the field 160 m apart (city/strip-spread.png), where they look good. The SPEC/brief rival head icons never deliver their information in real play.
issues.fix: Make the strip pack-aware. Stack badges that overlap into 2-3 lanes (or a cascade with ~60 % overlap, nearest rival on top), and add a '+N' chip when more than 3 share a spot. Alternatively add a zoomed pack window (about ±150 m around the player, ~240 px wide) beside the global bar, with ahead/behind gap ticks in metres. Keep species-coloured rims so the pile still shows who is where.

issues.title: Police siren glow is drawn over the HUD and tints every corner module
issues.detail: hud.ts appends edgesHost after hudLayer, so .eg-police (edges.css: inset box-shadow 120 px blur + 30 px spread at 0.85 alpha) lies on top of the place block, counters, speedo and cluster. During a chase the corners flash red/blue at 4 Hz. In coast/post-ult.png the place shard samples (195,40,68) instead of #E5191C, the speedo face turns navy and 5TH is washed blue. The soft haze also reads as a generic vignette rather than a P5 graphic.
issues.fix: Move .eg-police below hudLayer (into worldHost or before it) so the HUD stays clean. Make it a hard-edged P5 element: jagged red/blue light bars or diagonal hazard tape along the left/right edges stepping at 4 Hz, with the existing POLICE chip as its label.

issues.title: Place-change flash turns the red shard cyan / muddy mauve
issues.detail: .pl-flash (place.css) is a white layer with mix-blend-mode: difference, faded 1 -> 0 over 0.14 s in place.ts update(). White 'difference' over #E5191C gives cyan #1AE6E3, and the in-between frames are a dirty grey-mauve. This is visible in live/skill.png (teal shard) and city/pack-2.5s.png (brown-grey shard, crop 'pack-2.5s TL' in s-citycrop.jpg). Places flicker constantly in a pack, so this off-palette flash plays many times per race.
issues.fix: Flash with palette colours only: step the shard to white with a black numeral for 2 frames and back, or wipe a white diagonal slash clipped to the shard polygon. Drop mix-blend-mode.

issues.title: Calling card sits at a fixed lower-right spot and can cover the rival it introduces
issues.detail: intro.css .ic is fixed at stage px (1180,610)-(1840,950), and the race intro camera often frames the focus rider exactly there. r2-art/tools/intro.mjs (coast seed 4, every 6 frames, focus rider projected with app.camera) shows the card naming the right rider in 27/27 samples, so the r1 fix holds. But it covers more than 30 % of that rider's body in 3 samples (神烦狗 61 % at f60) and 10-16 % in 3 more (咕咕 f144-168). Screens: coast/intro-c.png (the 咕咕 card over the grey pigeon) and coast/intro-b.png.
issues.fix: Pick the card's side per subject: project the focus rider and place the card on the opposite half (lower-left when the rider is right of centre), or slide it vertically clear of the rider's box. Match the slam-in direction to the side.

issues.title: Bottom-right battle cluster hides rivals riding alongside
issues.detail: The cluster (bars + diamonds + weapon slot + portrait, 720x380 stage px, about 37 % x 35 % of the screen) is fully opaque. r2-art/tools/occl.mjs (every 0.5 s, first 60 s) found a rival's body more than 25 % behind it in 20/120 samples on city seed 2 (2 samples over 50 %, e.g. 薯条大盗 1.6-2.4 m behind on the right) and 6/120 on coast. In c720/race-a.png the shiba beside the player is mostly hidden behind the skill diamonds and HP bar. These are exactly the riders you swing at.
issues.fix: Add an occlusion fade: each frame, project riders within ~4 m. While a rider box intersects the bars, diamonds or weapon slot (not the portrait), drop them to ~40 % opacity, and restore over 0.2 s. Optionally tighten the skill row onto the bars to shrink the footprint.

issues.title: KO splash: title runs into the victim card and outlives short cinematics
issues.detail: (a) The ransom KNOCK OUT! is wider than the gap between the two cards, so the '!' sits on the victim card's frame (coast/ko-peak.png, live/ko.png; also 'DOUBLE KNOCK OUT!' in live/ko2.png). (b) For a repeat KO, fx plays the 60 % shorter cinematic and the HUD fades back at cine:ko end, but the splash keeps playing over the fully restored HUD. coast/ko-splash.png, 0.77 s after __br.ko, has the KO band crossing the cluster, speedo and timer with the HUD at alpha 1.
issues.fix: (a) Fit the title between the cards (scale to the available width, or ~150 px glyphs), or tuck the cards under the band ends. (b) When cine:ko 'end' arrives, exit the KO splash within ~150 ms, or keep the HUD at alpha 0 until the splash has left.

issues.title: 1ST place loses its celebration star
issues.detail: place.ts creates .pl-star before .pl-shadow/.pl-shard, and place.css puts it at left -46 px / top -30 px. The shard and numeral cover almost all of it and its top-left corner sits off-screen. Only one white star point shows (coast/finish-b.png, crop 'finish 1st place' in s-final.jpg). 1ST reads as a black block with a thin red '1', less festive than the red 2ND-8TH blocks.
issues.fix: Layer the star above the shard and below the numeral, or move it so it pokes out past the shard's right edge (around stage (260,40)), with an ink outline and its slow spin. 1ST should read as a reward at a glance.

issues.title: Yellow is used far beyond SP/warnings, diluting SHOWTIME READY
issues.detail: SPEC §5 reserves #FFE600 for SP and warnings. The HUD also uses it as a full plate for SLIPSTREAM/SLINGSHOT callouts (callouts.css .co-slip, the most frequent callout: the big yellow plate in city/pack-1s.png), for the speed arc and stripes while boosting (speedo.ts line 105, .spd-tag.boost), for the slipstream-ready tag, for achievement chips and for stun chips. A big yellow SLINGSHOT plate competes with SHOWTIME READY and the ult diamond, which should be the only yellow on screen besides hazards.
issues.fix: Recolour slipstream callouts to white/ink with black speed stripes, and the boost arc/stripes to hot red + white. Make achievement chips white-on-red with only a small gold icon. Keep yellow for SP, SHOWTIME READY, the ult diamond and real hazards (INCOMING, stun).

issues.title: cross-unit: corgi police lines are ui-screens toasts in the HUD chip zone and over cinematics
issues.detail: gameplay/race/police.ts say() calls app.ui.toast(). ui-screens' Toasts (src/ui/toast.ts) lays them out top-right from y = 14 % (151 px at 1080p), the same spot as the HUD's rival-skill/achievement chip stack (.chips top: 150 px·k). They are not hidden during cine:ko: coast/ko-peak.png shows 「柯基警官：就是你，大嘴的那个！」 on the letterbox above the KO splash. In coast/post-ult.png the toast is cut off at the right screen edge.
issues.fix: Race/core: emit the corgi's lines as `taunt` events from the police rider so the HUD bubble system handles them (side docking, quiet during cinematics). Failing that, ui-screens should hide in-race toasts while the HUD is quiet and offset them below the HUD chip stack.
